candidate_score_definition: Source suitability score based on official authority, freshness, spatial binding suitability and reproducibility. It is not a parcel-value accuracy claim.

candidates.title: DESNZ local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions, 2005 to 2024
candidates.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
candidates.recommended_use: Official authority-level baseline and reconciliation only.
candidates.parcel_rule: Never publish a local-authority total as a parcel measurement; preserve authority code and label AREA_LEVEL_PROXY.

candidates.title: NAEI gridded emissions data, 1 x 1 km
candidates.publisher: National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory / Defra / DESNZ
candidates.recommended_use: Priority source for documented parcel-centroid or polygon-intersection assignment.
candidates.parcel_rule: Preserve pollutant, year, grid identifier, sector and 1 km resolution; do not downscale the grid to a measured parcel value.

candidates.title: NAEI emissions from point sources, 2023
candidates.recommended_use: Exact point-in-polygon evidence for parcels containing an official source point.
candidates.parcel_rule: Bind only when the official point lies inside the parcel polygon; absence of a point source does not mean zero emissions.

candidates.title: NAEI UK Emissions Interactive Map, 2023
candidates.recommended_use: Browser cross-check and manual review, not the bulk source of record.
candidates.parcel_rule: Use as visual corroboration of downloaded official data and documented grid joins.

candidates.title: UK Spatial Emissions Methodology for NAEI 2023
candidates.recommended_use: Provenance, sector allocation and spatial-method documentation.
candidates.parcel_rule: Cite alongside every grid or point-source join; the report is not itself a parcel value source.

next_action: Live-probe all five official URLs, verify NAEI grid and point-source schemas, then bind only by documented grid containment/intersection or exact point-in-polygon.
